leah_sales: Passing off SageClinic pilot (SC-07). Two-week pilot starts Mon. Key asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering, dedicated pool ~20 qps, and embeddings for chart search. Primary contact: nate@sageclinic.health. Renewal signal: green if p95 < 120ms and embed cost < $0.0005/token.
mika_csm: Thanks — quick check: who owns peering vs data mapping?
leah_sales: Arun (infra) handles peering/provision; CS owns mapping and test payloads. Handover call Mon 9:30am PT.
arun_infra: Noted. Opening INF-9119 for reserved pool + static egress IPs in us-west-2. Need their peering CID and a maintenance window. Recommend prewarm to mitigate day-0 tail latency.
sam_support: Support rota: @sam_support weekdays 8-6 PT. I'll create SUP-6881 and private channel #sage-support. Please add runbook link.
leah_sales: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sageclinic (internal). Security docs uploaded to Drive.
mika_csm: Action items I have: 1) schedule Mon 9:30 handover (owner: leah_sales) 2) CS onboarding draft (owner: mika_csm) 3) INF-9119 follow-up (owner: arun_infra) 4) SAML metadata exchange (owner: nate@sageclinic / mika_csm). Anyone add SLA/renewal notes?
arun_infra: INF-9119 ETA: provisioned by Wed if peering approved. We'll use quant profile q4_8 to meet cost targets; capture eval prompts (need 8).
mika_csm: I'll run evaluation on q4_8 pre-launch. Leah — can you request 8 priority prompts from Nate?
sam_support: Support prep: SUP-6881 created. Monitoring thresholds: p95 latency > 130ms or error rate > 1% triggers page. I'll add warmup steps and a health-check script to the runbook.
hand-off-bot: handoff-bot: INF-9119 assigned to arun_infra.
mika_csm: Owners confirmed: CS = mika_csm; infra = arun_infra; support = sam_support; sales follow-ups = leah_sales. Next steps: 1) leah to collect prompts by Tue, 2) arun to update INF-9119 with IPs by Wed, 3) mika to publish onboarding plan by Wed EOD, 4) sam to post runbook updates and enable alerts.
leah_sales: Thanks all — I'll run the Mon 9:30 handover and invite Nate + infra lead. :thumbsup:
